title: Data Driven Locator Bar Hiding - Show Carved Pumpkins
description: An example data pack for the Data Driven Locator Bar Hiding mod that excludes Carved Pumpkins.
body:
This data pack is for use with the [Data Driven Locator Bar Hiding](https://modrinth.com/mod/data-driven-locator-bar-hiding) mod and will not function without it.

This data pack removes carved pumpkins from the `#wich:locator_bar_hidden` tag, allowing players wearing carved pumpkins on their heads to be shown on the locator bar.
